app.name: SahamatiCheck
app.tagline: Checks whether an app's privacy claims agree with each other.
tabs.label: Side panel sections
demo.label: Demo data
demo.banner: Demo data. The SahamatiCheck server could not be reached, so this panel shows a fabricated sample report for the demo app Chai Wallet. It says nothing about any real app.
demo.otherApp: This sample is not about the app open in this tab ({package}).
panel.noPackage: Open an app's page on Google Play, or enter a package name below.
panel.error: The report could not be loaded ({error}).
panel.notFound: There is no report for this app yet.
panel.staleCopy: The server could not be reached. Showing the saved copy from {date}.
job.title: Analysis in progress
job.background: You can close this panel. The check continues and the report will be saved.
coverage.title: Sources checked
coverage.partial: Coverage is partial, so some checks were skipped.
counts.title: What was found
counts.agree: Data types where the sources agree
counts.noScore: SahamatiCheck does not give apps a score or a grade.
source.apk_permission: The app package requests the permission
source.apk_sdk: The app package includes the SDK
finding.feedbackSent: Thank you. Your feedback was sent.
finding.feedbackFailed: Your feedback could not be sent.
finding.openInPage: Open this sentence in the policy
findings.title: Findings
findings.none: No strong or indicative findings for this version.
gaps.title: Not mentioned anywhere
gaps.intro: The app package shows evidence for these data types, but neither the policy nor the data-safety section mentions them. Silence is not a denial, so these are not counted as conflicts.
disclaimer.title: About this report
disclaimer.text: Automated static analysis. It may be wrong. This is a snapshot of one app version on the date shown. It is not legal advice and is not affiliated with Google.
policy.title: Policy highlighter
policy.intro: Highlights sentences on the privacy policy open in this tab. On-device highlights appear first. Nothing is sent to the server until you confirm on the page.
policy.injected: The highlighter is running on the page.
policy.needGesture: Chrome needs a direct action on the page first. Click the SahamatiCheck toolbar icon while the policy is open, or press Alt+Shift+S.
policy.none: No results for this tab yet.
policy.preliminaryNote: Preliminary on-device results only colour sentences. They never produce findings.
policy.error: The server analysis did not complete ({error}). On-device highlights are still shown.
policy.legend.strong: Quoted in a finding marked "Difference found"
policy.legend.indicative: Quoted in a possible difference, or one that needs a closer look
receipts.title: Consent receipts
receipts.intro: A local snapshot of what an app claimed on the day you looked. Receipts stay on this device and are never uploaded.
receipts.noChanges: No claim changes since the previous receipt.
receipts.unchanged: The claims match the latest receipt, so nothing new was saved.
receipts.noReport: Load a report first to save a receipt.
marker.label: SahamatiCheck: {n} finding(s) about {term} ({status}). Open the details in the side panel.
hl.title: SahamatiCheck
hl.ask: Send the visible text of this page ({n} characters) to {host} for the full analysis?
hl.preview: Preview of what will be sent
hl.failed: The server analysis did not complete. On-device highlights are still shown.
hl.noText: No readable text was found on this page.
options.title: SahamatiCheck settings
options.apiBaseHelp: The SahamatiCheck API. The default is http://localhost:8000.
options.autoHighlightHelp: Shows on-device highlights on pages that look like privacy policies. This asks Chrome for access to all https sites. Text is still only sent after you confirm.
options.contextMenu: Add "Analyse this privacy policy" to the right-click menu
options.contextMenuHelp: Asks Chrome for the context-menu permission.
options.notifications: Notify me when a report is ready
options.notificationsHelp: Asks Chrome for the notifications permission.
options.permissionDenied: Chrome did not grant the permission, so this setting stays off.
options.privacy: SahamatiCheck sends the package name of the app you check and, only after you confirm, the text of a policy page. It sends no browsing history, cookies or account details, and it has no analytics.
card.intro: Each row is checked on its own. SahamatiCheck does not give the app an overall colour, score or grade.
card.legacy: This saved report is from an older version and has no report card. Refresh to load the new view. Its findings are listed below.
color.green: No issue found in what we could check
strength.code_path: Evidence: found in the app's code
why.indicatorsIntro: These are not differences. They are things the app can do or uses that are not clearly explained.
why.empty.grey: We couldn't check this row. See "Rules not evaluated" below for what was missing.
why.empty.green: Nothing was found in the sources we could read. This is not a guarantee about the app.
why.empty.other: No further details are attached to this row.
limitations.title: Limits of this finding
limitation.permission_only: Based on a permission only. A permission shows what the app can do, not what it does.
limitation.sdk_presence_only: Based only on an SDK being present in the app. Being present does not show how it is used.
limitation.runtime_not_observed: We did not watch the app run, so we could not see what it actually sends.
limitation.confidence_below_confirm_thre: Our confidence is below the level needed to mark this as a confirmed difference.
limitation.unknown: Another limit was noted by the checker ({code}).
rules.title: Rules not evaluated
rules.intro: These checks could not run, usually because evidence was missing. A check that did not run is not counted as passed.
reason.runtime_evidence_unavailable: Needs the app to be run and watched, which this version does not do.
reason.test_account_unavailable: Needs a test account in the app, which was not available.
reason.policy_unavailable: The privacy policy could not be read.
reason.data_safety_unavailable: The data-safety section could not be read.
reason.apk_unavailable: The app package (APK) was not available.
reason.apk_unparseable: The app package could not be read.
reason.apk_partial_coverage: The app package was only partly readable, so the absence of something could not be confirmed.
reason.not_enabled_in_this_version: This check is not part of this version.
reason.missing_source_false_pass_prevent: A needed source was missing, so this check was not counted as passed.
reason.unknown: This check could not run (reason code: {code}).
notify.title: SahamatiCheck
app.staleBackend: The backend is older than this extension, so some parts of the report may be missing. Update or restart the backend.
